name: daily-goal
description: /daily-goal sets today's goal, keeps it in view above the prompt and asks at day's end if you got there.

askAfterHour.title: Ask after (hour)
askAfterHour.description: From this hour of the day (0-24, local time), the band asks whether you reached today's goal.

tellClaude.title: Tell Claude
tellClaude.description: Add today's open goal to the system prompt, so Claude keeps it in mind.
